# YOLO techniques

No ceiling; the Floor still applies (see `audition.md` §4).

| Technique | What the visitor sees | Suits |
|---|---|---|
| Image sequence | A product film the scroll bar plays | Packaged products |
| Sound | Music that answers the visitor | Experiences |

## Image sequence

### What it is

A product film cut into stills that the scroll bar plays forwards and backwards.

### Suits

Packaged products with a hero object.

### What it costs the visitor

About 25 MB of stills before the page was usable (1 site).

### Lighter version

The [Particles](fast.md#particles) card is not this technique, but it is the nearest lower card; the fallback is three key frames as pictures.

### For the builder

A 2D context draws the frame the scroll position picks.

#### Where the cost was measured

Fixed measurement examples; the project's references come from research (`identity.md` §6).

- example.com, 2026-11-03.

## Sound

### What it is

Music and effects that answer what the visitor does.

### Suits

Experiences meant to be watched like a film.

### What it costs the visitor

1.2 to 8.5 MB of sound (4 sites).

### Lighter version

No lighter version: silence is the fallback, and it is the default.

### For the builder

Fetch the sound only after the visitor turns it on.

#### Where the cost was measured

Fixed measurement examples; the project's references come from research (`identity.md` §6).

- example.com, 2026-11-03.
